Title: Software Developers
Description: Research, design, and develop computer and network software or specialized utility programs.

Title: Computer Programmers
Description: Create, modify, and test the code and scripts that allow computer applications to run.

Title: Computer Systems Engineers/Architects
Description: Design and develop solutions to complex applications problems, system administration issues, or network concerns.

Title: Data Scientists
Description: Develop and implement analytics applications to transform raw data into meaningful information using data-oriented programming and ML.

Title: Business Intelligence Analysts
Description: Produce financial and market intelligence by querying data repositories and generating periodic reports.

Title: Information Security Analysts
Description: Plan, implement, upgrade, or monitor security measures for the protection of computer networks and information.

Title: Software Quality Assurance Analysts and Testers
Description: Develop and execute software tests to identify software problems and their causes.

Title: Computer User Support Specialists
Description: Provide technical assistance to computer users and resolve technical support issues.

Title: Human Resources Managers
Description: Plan, direct, or coordinate human resources activities and staff of an organization.

Title: Human Resources Specialists
Description: Recruit, screen, interview, or place individuals within an organization.

Title: Labor Relations Specialists
Description: Resolve disputes between workers and managers, handle employee complaints and grievances.

Title: Accountants and Auditors
Description: Examine, analyze, and interpret accounting records to prepare financial statements and audit compliance.

Title: Financial and Investment Analysts
Description: Conduct quantitative analyses of information involving financial data, valuation, and forecasting.

Title: Sales Representatives, Wholesale and Manufacturing
Description: Sell goods and services requiring substantial technical or commercial knowledge.

Title: Sales Managers
Description: Plan, direct, or coordinate sales distribution, targets, and client management.

Title: Market Research Analysts and Marketing Specialists
Description: Research market conditions, customer trends, and competitor analytics.

Title: Search Marketing Strategists
Description: Employ search marketing tactics to increase visibility and customer engagement.
